text:
If you've still got evening plans on the water, get them wrapped up soon: that Lake Wind Advisory is real, with south winds gusting 15 to 25 knots on the broad waters tonight before easing after dark. The bigger story is the showers and storms moving in, likely before sunrise, and the Euro is notably wetter than the American model on this one, so I'd keep the rain jacket handy even if you dodge it early. Temps stay mild overnight, only dropping to around 64, and the lake itself is holding at a swimmable 78.

Tuesday flips the script nicely: mostly sunny, a high near 82, and winds swinging northwest as drier air moves in behind tonight's storms. The models are split on just how dry (the Euro trends a few degrees cooler and damper than the others), but I'm betting on the sunnier read. Good day to plan around outdoor plans without much worry. Tonight, though, keep the boats in if you can, and don't linger on the open water past dark.

week.blurb: Muggy with a shot of storms this afternoon near 83, then a soaker likely overnight, the Euro's the wetter bet.
Tuesday swings back to mostly sunny near 82, dry enough despite the Euro's flirtation with afternoon showers.
Wednesday's mostly sunny too, high near 81, with just a slight chance of afternoon storms.
Thursday turns wetter, showers and storms likely both day and night, high near 80.
Friday cools to near 74 with a slight shower chance, mainly along the mountains, valleys mostly dry.
Saturday's the pick of the week, sunny and refreshing with a high near 77 and lower humidity.
Sunday stays mostly sunny near 79, just a slight chance of afternoon showers creeping in later.
